newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Komercni to release H1 results Thur.
newsitem.headline: Czech Komercni to release H1 results Thur.

text.p: The largest Czech commercial bank, Komercni Banka a.s., said on Monday that it would release its first-half earnings results at a news conference scheduled for 9.30 a.m. (0730 gmt) on Thursday.
Prague equities analysts have forecast Komercni's first-half, after-tax profit at 1.8-2.4 billion crowns, according to international accounting standards (IAS).

For the first six months of 1996, Komercni's pre-tax profit dropped to 3.273 billion crowns from 4.466 billion in 1995, while net profit for the period dipped to 3.059 billion crowns from 3.061, according to IAS accounting.
Komercni rose 14 crowns on Monday's Prague Stock Exchange session to close at 1,630.
